audience: HR and payroll teams that read employee, location and time record data from Blink

useCases.title: Look up employees
useCases.text: List the employees of the Blink system with their numbers and dates. Open one employee by id for the full record.

useCases.title: Review locations
useCases.text: List the locations where work is done, with their active flag. Open one location by id for its details.

useCases.title: Read planning entries
useCases.text: List the planning entries with their dates, locations and planned durations.

useCases.title: Open one time record
useCases.text: Read one time record by id. The connection reads data only and cannot change Blink data.
